50_train-infer-contract_demo.py
"""Synthetic two-dimensional policy: split -> fit -> restore -> closed loop. CPU-only teaching experiment. The dynamics are s_next = s + action.The experiment checks software contracts, not performance on a robot."""import copyimport jsonimport subprocessimport sysimport tempfilefrom pathlib import Path import torchfrom torch import nn torch.set_num_threads(1)torch.manual_seed(83)HORIZON, ACTION_DIM = 3, 2CONFIG = {"horizon": HORIZON, "action_dim": ACTION_DIM,          "observation": "previous_state,current_state,goal",          "action": "world_delta", "unit": "synthetic_length", "dt": 1.0}  def model_factory(config):    # This expert is linear in the observation; a linear model isolates the pipeline.    return nn.Linear(6, config["horizon"] * config["action_dim"])  def make_episodes():    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(83)    episodes = []    for episode_id in range(60):        state = 2 * torch.rand(2, generator=generator) - 1        goal = 2 * torch.rand(2, generator=generator) - 1        previous = state.clone()        observations, actions = [], []        for _ in range(12):            action = 0.25 * (goal-state)            observations.append(torch.cat([previous, state, goal]))            actions.append(action)            previous, state = state, state+action        episodes.append({"id": episode_id, "obs": torch.stack(observations),                         "actions": torch.stack(actions), "goal": goal})    return episodes  def windows(episodes):    obs, actions, masks = [], [], []    for episode in episodes:        length = len(episode["obs"])        for t in range(length):            count = min(HORIZON, length-t)            chunk = torch.full((HORIZON, ACTION_DIM), float("nan"))            valid = torch.zeros(HORIZON, 1, dtype=torch.bool)            chunk[:count] = episode["actions"][t:t+count]            valid[:count] = True            obs.append(episode["obs"][t]); actions.append(chunk); masks.append(valid)    return torch.stack(obs), torch.stack(actions), torch.stack(masks)  def fit_statistics(train):    obs, actions, valid = train    selected_actions = actions[valid[..., 0]]  # [valid frames,D]    return {"obs_mean": obs.mean(0), "obs_std": obs.std(0, correction=0).clamp_min(1e-4),            "action_mean": selected_actions.mean(0),            "action_std": selected_actions.std(0, correction=0).clamp_min(1e-4)}  def prepare_data(episode_splits):    # The complete preparation entry point receives every split, but fits only train.    prepared = {name: windows(items) for name, items in episode_splits.items()}    return prepared, fit_statistics(prepared["train"])  def predict(model, stats, obs):    normalized = (obs-stats["obs_mean"]) / stats["obs_std"]    q = model(normalized).reshape(-1, HORIZON, ACTION_DIM)    return q * stats["action_std"] + stats["action_mean"]  def masked_error(prediction, target, valid):    mask = valid.expand_as(prediction)    if not mask.any():        raise ValueError("empty supervision")    p, y = prediction[mask], target[mask]    if not (torch.isfinite(p).all() and torch.isfinite(y).all()):        raise ValueError("nonfinite valid supervision")    return (p-y).square().mean()  def restore(path):    artifact = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)    if artifact["config"] != CONFIG:        raise ValueError("incompatible observation/action contract")    model = model_factory(artifact["config"])    model.load_state_dict(artifact["model"])    model.eval()    return model, artifact  def restore_check(path):    model, artifact = restore(path)    with torch.no_grad():        actual = predict(model, artifact["statistics"], artifact["probe"])    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, artifact["expected"], atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)    print("fresh-process prediction matches saved probe")  def run():    episodes = make_episodes()    train_episodes, validation_episodes, test_episodes = episodes[:40], episodes[40:50], episodes[50:]    split = {"train": [e["id"] for e in train_episodes],             "validation": [e["id"] for e in validation_episodes],             "test": [e["id"] for e in test_episodes]}    assert not (set(split["train"]) & set(split["validation"]) | set(split["train"]) & set(split["test"]))    episode_splits = {"train": train_episodes, "validation": validation_episodes, "test": test_episodes}    prepared, stats = prepare_data(episode_splits)    train, validation, test = (prepared[name] for name in ("train", "validation", "test"))    # Re-run the actual preparation entry point with altered held-out inputs.    altered_splits = copy.deepcopy(episode_splits)    for name in ("validation", "test"):        for episode in altered_splits[name]:            episode["obs"].add_(1000)            episode["actions"].add_(1000)    _, altered_stats = prepare_data(altered_splits)    for key, value in altered_stats.items():        torch.testing.assert_close(value, stats[key])     model = model_factory(CONFIG)    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.03)    x, y, valid = train    # Only selected targets are transformed; invalid NaN values never enter a loss.    normalized_x = (x-stats["obs_mean"]) / stats["obs_std"]    mask = valid.expand_as(y)    safe_y = torch.where(mask, y, stats["action_mean"])    normalized_y = (safe_y-stats["action_mean"]) / stats["action_std"]    losses = []    for step in range(600):        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)        q = model(normalized_x).reshape_as(y)        loss = masked_error(q, normalized_y, valid)        loss.backward(); optimizer.step()        if step in (0, 599): losses.append(float(loss.detach()))    model.eval()    with torch.no_grad():        validation_mse = float(masked_error(predict(model, stats, validation[0]), validation[1], validation[2]))        test_mse = float(masked_error(predict(model, stats, test[0]), test[1], test[2]))        probe = test[0][:8].clone()        expected = predict(model, stats, probe)    assert losses[-1] < losses[0]    assert validation_mse < 1e-4  # A contract test for this deliberately realizable toy problem.    artifact = {"model": {k: v.detach().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()},                "statistics": stats, "config": CONFIG, "split": split,                "probe": probe, "expected": expected}    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:        checkpoint = Path(directory)/"policy.pt"        torch.save(artifact, checkpoint)        # Exercise actual serialization and a new Python process, not just a state_dict alias.        subprocess.run([sys.executable, __file__, "--restore-check", str(checkpoint)], check=True)        restored, saved = restore(checkpoint)        final_errors = []        with torch.no_grad():            for episode in test_episodes:                previous = episode["obs"][0, :2].clone()                state = episode["obs"][0, 2:4].clone()                goal = episode["goal"]                for _ in range(24):                    obs = torch.cat([previous, state, goal])[None]                    action = predict(restored, saved["statistics"], obs)[0, 0]                    previous, state = state, state+action  # Execute one slot, then re-observe.                final_errors.append(float((state-goal).norm()))        # Fault injection: identical shapes do not establish compatible units.        broken = copy.deepcopy(artifact); broken["config"]["unit"] = "other_unit"        torch.save(broken, checkpoint)        try: restore(checkpoint)        except ValueError: pass        else: raise AssertionError("unit mismatch must be rejected")    print(json.dumps({"train_loss_first_last": losses, "validation_action_mse": validation_mse,                      "test_action_mse": test_mse, "closed_loop_mean_final_distance": sum(final_errors)/len(final_errors),                      "episodes": {key: len(value) for key, value in split.items()}}, indent=2))  if __name__ == "__main__":    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--restore-check": restore_check(sys.argv[2])    else: run()

预期结果

新进程恢复后的预测与保存探针一致，不兼容的单位配置被拒绝。固定种子教学运行的验证动作 MSE 约 3.26e-6，闭环平均终点距离约 0.00265；这些数值只描述本文的线性合成系统。
